newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds apathetic, await auction.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds apathetic, await auction.

text.p: Portuguese bonds edged higher in sympathy with Bonos to end an apathetic session with spreads steady around 20 basis points (bp) below 10-year Bonos as the market awaited tomorrow's three-year bond auction.
"Cash and futures are practically stuck as no one wants to take risks. Everything is the same at home and there are no relevant factors abroad," said one operator in late trade.
A dealer said: "The market reflects the calmness resulting from the U.S. holiday."
Money rates were calm. One month money stood at 6.87/6.92 percent, compared with 6.87/6.94 percent at the opening.
